method: Run from the worktree root in this order. First, candidate: the committed IB-pr-595 49financial transplant files were read (their sha256 checked against IB-pr-595's record); the change from e2700915d2 to 53c238604b in holdings_snapshot.py was taken as a three-way merge onto the transplanted file (ours transplant, base e2700915d2, theirs 53c238604b) with the conflicts counted; publication.py was kept unchanged; the candidate was written to the addendum folder and checked (the D spans stripped equal the transplant byte for byte, the D spans equal HEAD's, no one-date bypass, cusip_key present). Second, firm: the committed addendum files were copied into the minting-pin worktree, the bundle was built twice by the minting pin safe_deploy_core build_bundle_payload (BUILD ONLY, arm A and arm B), the live bundle was read with s3api head-object and get-object (read only) and compared member by member with the candidate, and six offline test files copied from HEAD were run with pytest on the candidate tree (the one-date bypass test was not run). Third, assemble wrote the record. Nothing was uploaded, minted, deployed, signed or written to AWS.
notes: Facts and their basis: the base is IB-pr-595's committed 49financial transplant, checked against its record; the D change is git diff e2700915d2 53c238604b of holdings_snapshot.py (56 inserted lines, no deleted line), applied as a three-way merge with 0 conflicts; HEAD equals the 53c238604b blob and HEAD with the D spans stripped equals the e2700915d2 blob.

Not read and not run: no Lambda was invoked and no publish, mint, land, refusal-record or upload function was called; build_bundle_payload was called twice in BUILD ONLY mode and its output stayed in scratch; no sign-in and no vendor contact; the live object version identifier is not written; test_holdings_bypass_one_date.py was not run because it tests the one-date bypass that is not shipped.

Sparse directories: the base worktree's sparse set gained data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting/ only (local, never committed); the minting pin is a full detached worktree outside the repository, with sparse checkout disabled there alone; the candidate tree's tests were copied in from HEAD and are not bundle members.
Tests: six offline files from HEAD run on the candidate tree: 98 passed, 0 failed, pytest rc 0; the failing test names, if any, are recorded in the criteria output and the channel rows.

The counters functions_invoked, sign_ins_made, aws_writes_made, rows_written, figures_written and vendor_requests_sent are zero: they count publish, mint, sign-in, write and vendor calls, and none was made.

Client data gate: the commit gate of the candidate files printed a WARN that the hashed account-id list is absent on this box, so those files and this record were NOT checked against it (absent is not empty); this record carries counts, hashes and repository paths only, and the harness prints no account, holding, value or object key.
